protocol: Real propagation workloads. One executor call per measured run. The sequential baseline is an explicit loop over propagate(), never a batch with one worker. Each configuration is warmed up and then repeated; every repetition is recorded and none is discarded.
timing_boundaries: propagate_batch exposes no timers. wall_seconds brackets the whole executor call. dispatch_seconds runs from executor entry to the earliest per-trajectory factory entry and therefore contains worker creation and scheduling latency: an upper bound on startup cost, not startup alone. active_envelope_seconds runs from that earliest factory entry to the latest RHS destruction and contains construction, propagation, destruction and every idle period inside the batch. join_return_seconds runs from that latest destruction to executor return. Per trajectory, trajectory_seconds spans factory entry to RHS destruction, propagation_seconds spans the first RHS call to RHS destruction, and construction and destruction are reported separately.
counter_instrumentation: RHS and atmosphere counts are plain local fields of each trajectory's own RHS object, incremented by its owning worker. No clock is read and nothing is allocated inside an RHS evaluation; the only clock reads are the five per-trajectory markers and the process CPU and RSS samples that bracket the run.
sequential_baseline_definition: executor "sequential" is a plain for loop calling propagate() once per trajectory on the calling thread. executor "batch" with requested_workers == 1 is the library's inline single-worker path, recorded separately so the two are never conflated.
control_definition: executor "control_no_rhs" repeats the matrix with an output schedule of {0}, where propagate() returns before evaluating the RHS at all, so it isolates thread launch, dispatch and join for both scheduling policies.
speedup_and_efficiency: Not computed here. Each batch run carries sequential_reference, the index of a sequential run of the same case, workload, variant, batch size and ap-history switch, so speedup is that run's wall_seconds over this run's wall_seconds and parallel efficiency is that speedup divided by requested_workers.
worker_workload_definition: worker_busy_seconds is the sum over that worker's trajectories of factory-entry to destruction; worker_span_seconds is that worker's first factory entry to its last RHS destruction. worker_busy_max_over_span is the largest busy/span ratio, so a value near one means no idle gap inside any worker and a smaller value means one; worker_busy_cv is the coefficient of variation of busy time across workers and measures load imbalance. Slots are assigned by first factory call on each thread, so a slot index is an execution order label, not a fixed worker identity across runs.
skipped_policy: A configuration is skipped only when the host cannot support its worker count, and every skip is listed with its reason. No workload, model or configuration is silently dropped.
spice_reuse_counters: Delta of SpiceEphemerisProvider::reuse_statistics() across the timed region, sampled outside it. Present only in a build whose environment library was compiled with LEO_SPICE_REUSE_DIAGNOSTICS; otherwise null with the reason.
native_mutex_counters: Total time serialized inside the native NRLMSISE-00 and JB2008 adapter mutexes and the contended share of acquisitions, from private measurement-only copies of those two adapter sources. Present only in a build compiled with MT_NATIVE_DIAGNOSTICS; otherwise null with the reason. No production lock, model or SPICE internal was modified.
memory_definitions: peak_rss_bytes is the process-lifetime high-water mark (ru_maxrss) and never decreases; rss_bytes_before and rss_bytes_after are instantaneous samples around the run, so rss_delta_bytes is the per-run change.
absolute_tolerances: project defaults: position 1e-3 m, velocity 1e-6 m/s, quaternion 1e-12, body rate 1e-12 rad/s
warmup_note: Warm-up runs are executed and their wall time recorded in execution_order, but they are not part of runs, so no summary can accidentally include a warm cache.

host.worker_affinity: no individual worker is bound; the whole process inherits the caller's affinity, so runs are only comparable with the same taskset mask

perturbation.method: splitmix64 stream seeded with seed + 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 * (trajectory_index + 1), uniform in [-sigma, sigma] from the top 53 bits, applied to position, velocity and body rate
